name: hub-look
description: The Settings and Screenshots tabs look right in the shared KydlCore theme and F6 / Esc open and close the hub with real keys

steps.message: Press F6, pick Valheim Discord Relay. Do the Settings and Screenshots tabs use the shared look (dark panel, gold accents, readable text, nothing cut off)?
Press Esc. Is the hub closed and can you move / look around again (input released)?
